newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANI may make Ellicott statement soon.
newsitem.headline: ANI may make Ellicott statement soon.

text.p: Heavy engineering firm Australian National Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that it could make an announcement about the Ellicott report by the end of July.
"What form the announcement will take I don't know," corporate affairs manager Frank Sufforini told Reuters.

High profile barrister Bob Ellicott was commissioned by ANI in late 1996 to report on the company's purchase of the loss-making German environmental business ABT in 1989, when the engineer was controlled by media boss Kerry Packer.
Ellicott was asked to consider whether any legal action could be taken, among other things.
